setup.text: Bramble hands over a small task scroll.

escalation.text: The scroll unfolds across the floor and out the door.

conflict.text: Pip asks whether seventeen tasks still count as one.

hook.text: Rook points a practice sword at a chair.

setup.text: The chair moved two inches during breakfast.

escalation.text: Rook orders a full defensive formation.

conflict.text: Vellum asks the chair for its terms.

punchline.text: The chair requests a quieter table.

setup.text: One potato must fund the entire cellar.

escalation.text: Tansy divides it into twelve imaginary quarters.

punchline.text: Dinner was removed in revision four.

setup.text: Muddle rotates an abstract strategy map.

escalation.text: Each rotation creates a more confident explanation.

conflict.text: Pip asks which way is north.

hook.text: Vellum arrives carrying the peace cup.

setup.text: The furniture war ended three minutes ago.

punchline.text: A productive dialogue would have been earlier.

hook.text: The empty cellar is over budget.

setup.text: Tansy audits shelves containing only dust.

escalation.text: Three imaginary barrels appear in the ledger.

hook.text: Drowse wakes beneath the strategy table.

setup.text: Pip says the emergency meeting is over.

escalation.text: Drowse checks the silent alarm bell.

conflict.text: The room is empty and one chair is smoking.

setup.text: Muddle calls it a minor visibility event.

escalation.text: Bramble adds the lantern to the damage ledger.

conflict.text: The sign now says no open flames.

hook.text: The alarm bell makes no sound.

setup.text: Tansy tests the clapper and the ledger.

conflict.text: Everyone asks how it can wake anyone.

punchline.text: It has never interrupted a nap.

hook.text: Muddle reveals a shortcut across one room.

setup.text: The route begins with four careful turns.

escalation.text: Twelve more stages appear, including provisions.

conflict.text: Vellum walks directly to the other side.

punchline.text: That route has no narrative structure.
